inspiration: Turn order: one function picks the next unit from the active units of both armies by speed, and a tie goes to whichever army moves first (src/fheroes2/battle/battle_arena.cpp lines 169-180). Keep the deterministic tie-break; use the input tick as the tie-break in the real-time duel.

Morale as a per-turn roll: a good or bad mode is rolled at the start of a unit's turn from its morale value; the AI avoids the bad mode more often than a human (src/fheroes2/battle/battle_troop.cpp line 301). Keep the per-turn roll that changes one action; change the presentation to an aura.

Stalemate guard: a counted limit on turns without a death (src/fheroes2/ai/ai_battle.cpp lines 678-690; retreat branch not read). Keep a counted no-kill limit; use a real-time no-hit timer with a countdown.

Battle stat table as data columns: attack, defence, damage min and max, hit points, speed, shots, abilities, weaknesses (src/fheroes2/monster/monster_info.cpp line 234 header, table from line 233). Data-first shape for rows 20 and 21.
Tier sharing: several creature tiers point to one animation file (monster_info.cpp line 147). An upgrade reuses the base sheet and changes only its stat row; change the visuals to show the upgrade.
Idle loops by name: a numbered six-frame loop per prop or critter, and transition loops for buildings (files/data/resurrection.h2d entry names only). Idle vocabulary for rows 7 and 14.
